Package com.listochef.repository

Interface UserRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
MongoUserRepository
public interface UserRepository
Repository interface for user operations. This interface defines the contract for managing users, including authentication-related actions, profile updates, pantry/grocery management, saved recipes, and tickets.
